ambiguity_flags.note: The proposed term 'decision_layer' cannot be cleanly distinguished between (1) the architectural Layer-3 label and (2) the planned 'Decision Engine' component listed in CLAUDE.md Section 3.2 as a named subcomponent of Layer-3. 'decision engine' is an explicitly DISCOURAGED variant of LAYER_3. Adopting 'decision_layer' introduces an unresolved mapping requiring downstream governance consumers to distinguish an architectural layer from a named subcomponent using near-identical vocabulary. Under fail-closed principle (CLAUDE.md Section 7), this ambiguity is a blocking condition.

The proposed term 'truth_store' is semantically ambiguous between (1) the full Layer-2 operational surface — ingestion adapters, series-registry-governed processing, and snapshot publication — and (2) only the snapshot storage/publication endpoint. This scope underspecification weakens the snapshot boundary concept (Category A) by allowing 'truth_store' to be interpreted as referring only to the storage artifact rather than the full deterministic ingestion-and-publication architecture that Layer-2 governs.
